snippet.title: Plug n Play Games: Spider-Man Triple Threat
snippet.description:
Help support the channel: https://www.patreon.com/ZCInfinity


Another "motion-sensing" game where one punches at a sensor or pushes the buttons on the gloves in a desperate attempt to register a punch or movement! Take on Green Goblin, Rhino, and Venom as you stop them from... Whatever they were doing! And don't attempt the harder difficulties. Life isn't long enough...
